title: Grants.gov
description: The official U.S. federal grant database. Search, find, and apply for federal grant opportunities across all federal agencies.

title: SAM.gov
description: Official U.S. government system for entity registration. Required registration to apply for federal grants and manage federal awards.

title: USAspending.gov
description: Official source for federal spending data. Search grant awards to see which agencies and organizations receive funding.

title: Candid (Foundation Directory Online)
description: Free funder profiles and the free edition of Foundation Directory Online to research private and corporate foundations.

title: GrantWatch
description: Searchable database of currently available grants from government, foundation, and corporate funders.

title: GrantStation
description: Grant database and funder research tools for nonprofit organizations seeking funding.

title: Grants.gov Learning Center
description: Official guidance on finding, applying for, and managing federal grants, including applicant training and videos.

title: U.S. Department of Education Grants
description: Federal education grants and funding opportunities from the U.S. Department of Education.

title: Institute of Museum and Library Services (IMLS)
description: Federal grants for libraries and museums to support education, access, and community services.

title: National Endowment for the Arts (NEA)
description: Federal grants supporting arts projects, arts education, and cultural organizations nationwide.

title: National Endowment for the Humanities (NEH)
description: Federal grants supporting humanities research, education, preservation, and public programs.

title: U.S. EPA Grants
description: Environmental Protection Agency grant opportunities and application guidance for environmental and public health projects.

title: AmeriCorps Grants
description: Federal grants and funding opportunities supporting national service, volunteering, and community programs.

title: U.S. Department of Health & Human Services (HHS) Grants
description: Official HHS grant policies, guidance, and resources for health and human services funding.

title: National Institutes of Health (NIH) Grants
description: NIH funding opportunities, application instructions, and grant writing guidance for health research.

title: NIH Guide for Grants and Contracts
description: The official NIH guide to funding opportunities, application procedures, and grant writing guidance.

title: U.S. Small Business Administration (SBA)
description: SBA guidance on small business grants, funding programs, and grant writing basics for small businesses.

title: SCORE
description: Free business plan, proposal, and financial templates from SCORE, a nonprofit resource partner of the SBA.

title: SBA Budget Templates
description: Free small business budget worksheets and financial planning templates from the U.S. Small Business Administration.
